category: debrid resale - Russian account shop (account, not key)

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
binding_note: The account is delivered with the seller's mailbox behind it; the vendor's location check sends its PIN there, so the buyer's first new-network login depends on the seller answering.
confidence_note: the seller's page was read today; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'Премиум-аккаунт Real Debrid на 90 дней (RD N°3)' 855 RUB; 'Премиум-аккаунт Real Debrid на 180 дней (RD N°4)' 1 520 RUB; instant delivery to email.
free_tier.notes: the product is titled 'premium account', not 'voucher' - the buyer receives credentials, not a code to redeem on their own account

egress.terms: the listing restates the vendor's features ('более 80 популярных серверов файлового хостинга'); no byte allowance is published by the shop

limits.value: one holder per account; the seller created the account and keeps its mailbox, so a location change needs the seller

identity_cost.detail: order by email; Russian rails (the site advertises a hotline and WhatsApp/Telegram support). The account's own email is the seller's.

reliability_note: Buyer reviews on the page are short and positive (2025-08-10 to 2026-05-07), which is the seller's own wall, not an independent rating.

evidence.proved: 90-day 855 RUB and 180-day 1520 RUB listings, 'Премиум-аккаунт' wording, and dated buyer comments on the page
the 180-day product page at 1520 RUB and four buyer comments dated 2025-08-10 to 2025-08-27 plus one 2026-05-07 testimonial on the category page

'The User's account is for personal use only. Only the individual who holds the account is allowed to connect on it. Connections to the User's account are recorded so that we can detect account sharing.' and 'Any account sharing or generated links sharing will lead to a suspension of the User account.' and 'not allowed to resell any Premium account nor managing it for somebody else without our explicit permission'

notes: If 1520 RUB is close to EUR 16 at the current rate, this is the only shop found selling at roughly the vendor's own price - because it is selling a hand-made account, not a voucher. The caveat is the mailbox: the buyer cannot reset the password or pass the vendor's new-location PIN without the seller.
